query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing unexpected temperature profile variations in our atmospheric distillation unit. Can you help diagnose potential root causes?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Conduct a thorough investigation to identify the root causes of temperature profile anomalies in an atmospheric distillation unit, considering process deviations and equipment malfunctions.
